name: Moped
description: A motor-driven cycle whose motor produces no more than 2 brake horsepower and can't propel it faster than 35 mph on level ground; an electric motor may be no more than 750 watts.

restrictions.rule: A motor-driven cycle: a seat or saddle for each rider, and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor produces no more than 2 brake horsepower and can't propel it faster than 35 mph on level ground (47 O.S. §1-133.2)
An electric motor may be no more than 750 watts; a combustion engine no more than 50 cc, with an automatic drive (47 O.S. §1-133.2)
A seated electric two-wheeler of 750 watts or less that falls outside the three electric-assisted bicycle classes, such as a throttle bike faster than 20 mph, lands here
Registered with Service Oklahoma on the staggered yearly cycle
May not be ridden faster than 35 mph, or faster than the posted limit
Riders under 16 may not carry passengers; older riders may carry one only on a factory double seat with footrests and wheels at least 12 inches in diameter
May not pass other vehicles between lanes of traffic
Takes the bicycle lighting, reflector and brake equipment rules rather than the motor vehicle ones
